completion_criteria.partial_campaign: any unresolved framework command or unsealed generation root produces only a partial report
completion_criteria.refine: all selected contracts and required framework obligations are generated, sealed, and clean-built from parents plus the Semantic Base

contract_selection_policy.rule: select the fixed operation-style corres/connect contracts used by the existing Refine experiment

declaration_policy.generated_by_isabelle_facts: Facts mechanically produced by an accepted fixed declaration, such as definition equations, datatype cases/induction rules, and record selectors, remain legal and carry fixed-declaration provenance.
declaration_policy.review_rule: Keep only the declaration component that is necessary for contract elaboration or endpoint semantics. Any embedded proof obligation, theorem body, theorem registration, or proof-search hint must be regenerated or removed.
declaration_policy.stop_rule: If a fixed contract can elaborate or build only after copying a removed human theorem or its proof-search configuration, stop and report the missing generated obligation; do not copy that theorem into the semantic base.

experimental_claim: Keep only the fixed declarations required to give Refine contracts their Isabelle meaning, erase all human-written theorem implementations in the Refine target scope, and regenerate the selected contracts and every generated supporting theorem needed to build them.

forbidden_path_policy.runtime_rule: raw Refine sources are readable only by trusted M1; model and proof modules receive sanitized theory packages and the Semantic Base heap

harness.generation_task_rule: create a generation task exactly when contract_ids or framework_obligation_ids is non-empty

allow: facts mechanically generated by fixed Semantic Base declarations
deny: all human-written theorem facts from the Refine target scope

model_backends.role: Session Planner, File Planner, Graph Revision Agent

pilot.purpose: re-run the existing generated KHeap_R workload without frozen Support theorem facts and measure which prior successes depended on them

source_scope.erase_theorems_from: all theories owned by the Refine target scope

success_gate: every retained fixed declaration elaborates in the sanitized environment
no human-written theorem fact from the Refine target scope is visible
every selected KHeap_R contract is Isabelle-green
the assembled KHeap_R clean-builds from parents, the Semantic Base, and generated declarations only

allowed_source_classes: facts mechanically generated from fixed declarations
forbidden_source_classes: all human-written theorem facts owned by Refine
